chunks: And he recited it to them, [and they believed], had they been believers in it.
ai.seo_question: Why did the people reject Prophet Muhammad's message according to Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the intrinsic link between internal conviction (Iman) and external acceptance of divine revelation, suggesting that the Qurayh's rejection of the Quran was a symptom of their spiritual hardness rather than mere intellectual disagreement. It reflects the broader theological principle that true faith necessitates a receptive heart, a concept emphasized by Imams like Al-Baqir and Al-Sadiq when discussing the conditions of prophetic acceptance.
